snippet.title: Star and Serpent Solitaire
snippet.description:
Star and Serpent Solitaire is a Klondike-style solitaire variant using a 56-card tarot deck with four extra Page cards and 3-card deals.
https://www.starandserpent.com/games/catalogue/StarAndSerpentSolitaire/
